sam_sales: Quick heads-up: Athena (prospect) wants a short POC checklist — they need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (delta and bulk), per-tenant RBAC, and domain-level claim locking.
jas_eng: Do they want Hosted or Dedicated for the POC?
sam_sales: Hosted to start but they asked about SLA, encrypted assertions, and whether SCIM deltas count as billable tokens/requests.
priya_se: Hosted supports SAML and SCIM out of the box. Domain verification can be DNS TXT or email proof; once verified we can enable restrict_signup_to_verified_domains for that tenant. RBAC mapping can be SCIM groups -> roles or via our role-mapping webhook.
alex_security: From security: require SAML attribute mapping (email, sub, tenant_id), signed assertions, SP-initiated support, and IdP metadata upload. They asked about encrypted assertions — we should clarify Hosted limitations.
jas_eng: We support signed assertions and SP-init today on Hosted. Encrypted assertions require extra cert management and are supported on Dedicated/Private as a config option. For Hosted POC, we can accept signed assertions only.
sam_sales: SCIM rate limits question — what are defaults and options for initial bulk imports vs ongoing deltas?
priya_se: Defaults: 60 req/min per org for SCIM with a bulk import endpoint for initial push. For large initial syncs use the bulk endpoint (example): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/scim/bulk -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @bulk.json
```
priya_se: If they need sustained >60rpm we can request a temporary burst for the POC; support will approve on a case-by-case basis to avoid immediate Dedicated migration.
alex_security: RBAC nuance: for repo-level or resource-level entitlements we usually implement a mapping webhook or small transform service that converts SCIM groups/attributes into resource-scoped roles. Do they expect attribute-based access control (ABAC) or group->role mapping?
sam_sales: The technical contact mentioned role-per-repo style control (fine-grained). They want to see a demo mapping webhook during the POC.
jas_eng: We can provide a sample mapping webhook (node + python examples) and host it on our sandbox for the demo. We'll need Athena's role schema to wire it up.
sam_sales: Domain locking: can we restrict signups to only verified domains? They want that enforced at onboarding and during provisioning.
priya_se: Yes — enable restrict_signup_to_verified_domains at tenant level after domain TXT verification. We can demo the flow in Hosted POC.
sam_sales: Pricing follow-up: enabling SCIM burst + building a mapping webhook — any extra POC fees?
jas_eng: SCIM burst for short-term POC is usually free. Custom webhook dev + hosted sandbox is included for enterprise POCs above threshold; sales to confirm with pricing. Sustained high throughput bumps billing.
priya_se: Also note session TTLs: default token TTL is 1h on Hosted, Dedicated supports longer TTLs. Athena asked for 12h — Hosted can be extended to 8h temporarily for POC; Dedicated is configurable per contract.
Alex_security: I'll assemble a short security note covering encrypted assertion limitations on Hosted, required SAML attributes, audit logging availability, and SCIM audit trails. Will attach separately. :+1:
deploy-bot: sandbox sid-az4 scheduled for Athena demo 2024-10-04 14:00 UTC.
sam_sales: Thanks — action items: (1) I'll confirm Hosted vs Dedicated with Athena; (2) Jas to prepare mapping webhook samples and deploy to sandbox; (3) Priya to prepare SCIM bulk example + request temporary burst if needed; (4) Alex to draft security one-pager about SAML/SCIM/rbac and encrypted assertion caveats.
sam_sales: Scheduling technical runbook call with Athena for tomorrow morning. Ping me if anything blocks.
